# Paggi Pazzo

> > Authentic Italian and grilling recipes from Rome to Texas, featuring Roman cuisine, wood-fire cooking, and charcoal-grilled dishes.

Paggi Pazzo is a culinary blog celebrating traditional Italian cooking techniques, especially Roman classics like Pasta alla Carbonara and homemade pizza dough, alongside charcoal and wood-fire grilling recipes. The site bridges Italian cucina traditions with international flavors from Spain, Greece, Mexico, and Uruguay.

## Key Topics

- Roman cuisine
- Charcoal grilling
- Italian cooking
- Wood-fire cooking
- Pasta recipes
- Pizza recipes
- Brick oven pizza
- Reggiano Parmigiano
- Prosciutto di Parma
- Pecorino Romano
- Soppressata
- Grilling techniques
- Italian recipe traditions
- Homemade pizza dough
- Authentic Carbonara

## Essential Recipes & Core Pages

- [Easy Recipes for the Grill & Cucina - Paggi Pazzo | Grilling and Cooking Recipes to Share & Enjoy](https://paggipazzo.com): Homepage: grilling & Roman cooking recipes from Italy to Texas and Brazil
- [Recipes | Easy Recipes for the Grill & Cucina - Paggi Pazzo](https://paggipazzo.com/recipes): Recipe collection: pasta, pizza, grilled dishes, and Italian cuisine

## Traditional Roman & Italian Pasta

- [Pasta alla Carbonara – Stop the Cream on Carbonara Crimes! | Easy Recipes for the Grill & Cucina - Paggi Pazzo](https://paggipazzo.com/2011/11/10/pasta-carbonara-recipe): Authentic Roman Pasta alla Carbonara recipe without cream
- [Pasta Aglio e Olio and Rosemary Pork Chops | Easy Recipes for the Grill & Cucina - Paggi Pazzo](https://paggipazzo.com/2011/08/31/pasta-aglio-olio-recipe): Traditional Roman Pasta Aglio e Olio with rosemary garlic pork chops

- [Roman Pizza Dough Recipe | Easy Recipes for the Grill & Cucina - Paggi Pazzo](https://paggipazzo.com/recipes/roman-pizza-dough-recipe): Homemade Roman thin crust pizza dough with Caputo tipo 00 flour
- [Thanksgiving Brick Oven Pizza with Prosciutto di Parma and Goat Cheese Recipe | Easy Recipes for the Grill & Cucina - Paggi Pazzo](https://paggipazzo.com/recipes/thanksgiving-brick-oven-pizza-with-prosciutto-di-parma-and-goat-cheese-recipe): Brick oven Thanksgiving pizza with Prosciutto di Parma and goat cheese

## Charcoal & Wood-Fire Grilling

- [Paella on the Grill (and Sangria on the side) | Easy Recipes for the Grill & Cucina - Paggi Pazzo](https://paggipazzo.com/2011/08/19/paella-on-the-grill-and-sangria-on-the-side): Spanish paella grilled over charcoal wood fire with sangria
- [Grilled Chicken with Garlic, Lemon, and Pepper Recipe | Easy Recipes for the Grill & Cucina - Paggi Pazzo](https://paggipazzo.com/recipes/chicken-garlic-lemon-recipe): Wood charcoal grilled chicken with garlic, lemon, and pepper
- [Grilled Swordfish Recipe | Easy Recipes for the Grill & Cucina - Paggi Pazzo](https://paggipazzo.com/recipes/grilled-swordfish-recipe): Grilled swordfish with lemon, garlic over hickory and oak charcoal
- [Grilled Greek Style Chicken Kabobs Recipe | Easy Recipes for the Grill & Cucina - Paggi Pazzo](https://paggipazzo.com/recipes/grilled-greek-chicken-kabobs-recipe): Greek chicken kabobs with Kalamata olives and feta cheese
- [Grilled Mexican Style Steak Fajitas – Si Se Puede!!! | Easy Recipes for the Grill & Cucina - Paggi Pazzo](https://paggipazzo.com/2013/07/05/grilled-mexican-style-steak-fajitas-si-se-puede): Mexican grilled steak fajitas with Goya Adobo marinade
- [Grilled Stuffed Zucchini Recipe (Zapallitos Rellenos) | Easy Recipes for the Grill & Cucina - Paggi Pazzo](https://paggipazzo.com/recipes/uruguayan-grilled-stuffed-zucchini-recipe): Uruguayan Zapallitos Rellenos with Prosciutto di Parma
